parent_stage4_freeze: freeze.json; preserve original unchanged; addendum is append-only; local freeze SHA not independently available

safety_and_source_limits.service_bulletin_reference_policy: Do not add bulletin/reproduction unless public official source verified; any workshop thresholds are context only, never numerical BMS diagnostic thresholds.

split_policy.existing_seeded_TR01_TR02_TE01_TE02: Retain historical IDs and seeds; no retroactive renaming, repeated measurements of previous comparisons excluded from new post-freeze scoring.
split_policy.new_seed_generation: SHA-256 of literal 'TAYCAN4R|hypothesis|split|severity|replicate|physics-or-observer-or-aux-or-nuisance', first 8 hex digits as unsigned big endian integer; no inspection-based seed selection
split_policy.nuisance_draw_policy: Draw once per episode for persistent biases, independently per channel; draw per time step for innovations, common random numbers across matched M01/I01 experiments. Distributions assumed, not fitted.
split_policy.validation_usage: Validation only for model/baseline selection and threshold settings; test locked until selected design frozen.

energy_balanced_long_horizon.charging_boundary: Negative battery-side DC power injected before electrical balance; no charger/OBC subsystem simulated
energy_balanced_long_horizon.charge_power_design: One healthy H00 calibration run using training-only reference profile to compute electrical energy before charge. Determine single reference negative battery-side power for final 12 minutes via fixed bisection bracket 0..120 kW, 5 iterations maximum, target final SOC within 0.5 pp of initial and 30..80% at all points. Freeze fixed power and reuse across fault hypotheses/severities/test seeds; no per-fault or test tuning.
energy_balanced_long_horizon.stress_abort_rule: If resulting battery model SOC crosses 30..80%, mark boundary violation and report with attempted energy and cause; do not clip or silently exclude.
energy_balanced_long_horizon.previous_results_6h: SUPERSEDED; do not use old B01 B02 B04 metrics

matched_M01_I01.objective: For each M01 candidate severity, choose I01 severity minimizing absolute difference in average extra dissipated W over same fixed full profile versus H00, using train-only physical truth/diagnostic loss channels; compute joule-integral; DIFF mapping affects observations, not physical losses.
matched_M01_I01.severity_mapping: Calibrate I01 severity by train-only monotone root search / interpolation; tolerance <=1% relative dissipation, otherwise report unmatched. Do not use holdout truth to match.
matched_M01_I01.separability: Report distributions/overlap and paired effect-size; DO NOT invent classifier/AUC without Stage5; do not use truth channel to derive R33.

external_validation_protocol.model_class: one-RC Thevenin ECM at individual cell scale only
ocv_models: linear voltage vs SOC as frozen model.py functional form
degree-3 polynomial in SOC, constrained/evaluated on 0..1 domain
external_validation_protocol.fit_only: LG E66 cell HPPC, GITT, C20 and C/3 files at -20,-10,10,25 degC; files enumerated from original archive manifest before new numerical fitting; no module or whole-pack fitting
external_validation_protocol.validate: LG E66 0.5C at development temperatures + 1C at development temperatures; blind temperature holdouts 0C and 40C all test types
external_validation_protocol.predictions: terminal V(t) under measured current profile using known initial SOC from development protocol (no fitted test SOC) and frozen input temperature treatment
external_validation_protocol.metrics: RMSE voltage V by full independent session, also MAE and temporal residual diagnostics; report per temperature/type and macro by independent sessions
external_validation_protocol.primary_threshold_assumed: cell voltage holdout RMSE <=0.100 V, no retuning; compare cubic vs linear and report both regardless of who wins
external_validation_protocol.scope: Tests transfer of ECM structure under cell-scale experimental regimes. Does not validate the 2022 Taycan 4S pack simulator or certified HV diagnosis.

LG_E66_split.metadata_manifest_previously_generated: LG_E66_MANIFEST.json; complete archive member paths/CRC/size originally catalogued
LG_E66_split.previously_exposed_policy: 25degC Drive Cycle not considered a virgin blind holdout; descriptive QC only; original numerical inspection is explicitly disclosed.
LG_E66_split.nominal_capacity_conflict: Another group page reportedly lists 60Ah; preserve 65Ah as README stated value and treat disagreement as UNRESOLVED pending identity/revision check. Do not silently normalize currents based on 60 or 65.
LG_E66_split.license: CC BY 4.0 confirmed in both original README files

Oxford_split.policy_pre_registered: Flag all rows, preserve all metadata. Exclude flagged trajectories from primary OCV/ECM fitting and primary holdout metrics, retain in raw QC and report secondary sensitivity with flags. Do not open or alter blind Cell7/8 before model freeze.
Oxford_split.inferred_q_units: Likely mAh because |q| up to ~745 for published nominal 740 mAh; INFERENCE not proved by manufacturer metadata.

metrics_and_baselines.multiclass_Brier: mean_i sum_classes (p_ic-1[y_i=c])^2; all 12 classes; report uncertainty by episodes
metrics_and_baselines.ECE: 10 fixed-width confidence bins over [0,1], top-class confidence ECE; also reliability table
metrics_and_baselines.expected_cost: per-episode sum over class posterior times assumed loss of chosen action
metrics_and_baselines.assumed_loss_matrix: correct=0; false-positive on H00=1; missed non-H00 fault as H00=10; incorrect non-H00 fault subtype=4
baselines: physics-rule residual thresholds fit on train and chosen on validation
regularized multinomial logistic regression on identical observed features, train-only standardization, validation-only tuning
metrics_and_baselines.evaluation_design: Holdout by whole episode / whole cell. Macro by episode, paired bootstrap by episode, do not split correlated timestamps across train and test.
